description: CDK infrastructure stack: DynamoDB tables, API Gateway with basic auth, Lambda functions, S3+CloudFront for SPA hosting, SNS topic, security group management IAM policies. This is the foundational CDK app that all other features build on.
steps: Create platform/ directory structure: package.json, tsconfig.json, cdk.json, bin/app.ts, lib/ for stacks
Initialize CDK app in platform/bin/app.ts with a single stack TpotBookingStack

Create lib/tpot-booking-stack.ts with: (a) DynamoDB table 'BookingTable' with partition key bookingId and GSI on instanceType+status for conflict detection, (b) DynamoDB table 'NotificationConfigTable' for notification settings per user/global, (c) S3 bucket for frontend SPA with CloudFront distribution, (d) API Gateway REST API with Lambda authorizer for basic auth (user/pass from SSM Parameter Store), (e) SNS topic for email notifications, (f) IAM role for backend Lambda with EC2, DynamoDB, SNS, SSM, S3 permissions, (g) IAM role for capacity poller Lambda with EC2 RunInstances/TerminateInstances/DescribeInstances, DynamoDB, SNS, SSM permissions
Create lib/lambda-authorizer.ts: a Lambda@Edge or API Gateway custom authorizer that checks Basic Auth credentials from SSM SecureString '/tpot-booking/basic-auth-credentials'
Add CDK outputs for: API Gateway URL, CloudFront distribution domain, DynamoDB table names, SNS topic ARN
Add package.json dependencies: aws-cdk-lib, constructs, @types/node, typescript, jest, ts-jest, aws-cdk-lib/assertions
Create a basic cdk synth test in test/tpot-booking-stack.test.ts that validates the stack synthesizes without error and contains expected resources
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd platform && npm install && npm run build' succeeds without errors
Running 'cd platform && npx cdk synth' produces a valid CloudFormation template in cdk.out/
The synthesized template contains DynamoDB tables, API Gateway, Lambda functions, S3 bucket, CloudFront distribution
Running 'cd platform && npm test' passes the basic synth test
verification: cd platform && npm install && npm run build
